description: Every TreasurySpring read endpoint, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers portfolio-level questions no single API call can: maturity ladders, obligor concentration, consolidated book, and event diffs.

auth_env_var_specs.name: TS_BEARER_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Pre-minted bearer token. OR set TS_CLIENT_ID + TS_CLIENT_SECRET and run `ts auth login`.

auth_env_var_specs.name: TS_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client id; used by `ts auth login` to mint a token at /oauth/token.

auth_env_var_specs.name: TS_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth2 client secret; used by `ts auth login`.

novel_features.name: Cash-flow forecast / maturity ladder
novel_features.description: Week-by-week projection of cash landing back, with maturities shifted to real settlement dates across all entities.

novel_features.name: Obligor concentration
novel_features.description: Total credit exposure to each obligor as a share of the consolidated book, flagging self-set limit breaches.

novel_features.name: Consolidated group book
novel_features.description: One portfolio across every legal entity: total invested, weighted-average yield/maturity, currency split.
